name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Home dialog/dialog.c; restores the screen block snapshotted in a transient sprite-backup buffer and frees it. Name accurately reflects cleanup (restore + free) of a dialog sprite buffer. No address residue.
purpose: Undo a transient overlay-sprite blit: restore the pre-blit screen content saved inside saved_block back to dst at the given stride, then free the temp buffer.
logic_summary: void cleanup helper. After the Watcom __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue, calls fd2_restore_screen_block_from_buffer(saved_block, dst, stride) to repaint the saved screen region (saved_block holds an 8-byte header [w,h,dst_offset] followed by w*h saved pixels), then free(saved_block). Plain RET, no value. Disassembly: PUSH 0x14;CALL __CHK -> CALL 0x4e92c (3 args, cdecl) -> CALL free (1 arg) -> RET; matches src exactly.
signature: void fd2_cleanup_dialog_sprite_buffer(uint32 saved_block, uint32 dst, uint32 stride)

params.name: saved_block
params.semantics: Saved-block buffer pointer: 8-byte header (uint16 width @0, uint16 height @2, uint32 dst_offset @4) then width*height saved pixel bytes. Restored to screen then freed.
params.reason: Accurately names the saved screen-block backup buffer; matches the callee fd2_restore_screen_block_from_buffer parameter name; no address residue.

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address the saved block is restored to (call sites pass 0xa0000, the Mode 13h VGA segment A000:0).
params.reason: Accurate destination-base name; matches callee parameter; no address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance dst per row during restore (call sites pass 0x140 = 320, the Mode 13h screen pitch).
params.reason: Accurate pitch/stride name; matches callee parameter; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Binary RET leaves EAX at entry value; the decompiler shows no return and all 13 callers discard, confirming void.

notes: src comment block (lines 14-23) already precise and correct: restore saved_block to dst at stride then free; pairs with fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_with_alloc / fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk; undoes transient sprite blit. __CHK(0x14) is the Watcom compiler stack-probe prologue (not game logic) and is correctly omitted from src. Ghidra plate matches refined understanding (adds a Body pseudocode block) -> left untouched. Verified callee semantics via blitspr.c fd2_restore_screen_block_from_buffer doc + disassembly. 13 call sites (7 distinct callers) all discard the (nonexistent) return -> void confirmed.
